title: Kafka Topics, Partitions and Consumer Groups
summary: Producers append records to topic partitions on KRaft-managed brokers; consumer groups read each partition independently and track offsets.

nodes.label: Producer
nodes.detail: Chooses a partition by record key or round-robin and sends batches to the partition leader.

nodes.label: Topic
nodes.detail: Logical stream split into partitions. Ordering is guaranteed only within a partition.

nodes.label: Partition 0
nodes.detail: Append-only log segment files. One leader serves reads and writes; followers replicate.

nodes.label: Partition 1
nodes.detail: Another partition with its own leader and follower replicas on different brokers.

nodes.label: Broker
nodes.detail: Server hosting partition replicas. In-sync replicas ensure data survives a broker failure.

nodes.label: KRaft Controllers
nodes.detail: Raft-based controller quorum that manages cluster metadata, leader election and topic configuration, replacing ZooKeeper.

nodes.label: Consumer Group
nodes.detail: Members of a group divide partitions between them, so each partition is read by one member at a time.

nodes.label: Committed Offsets
nodes.detail: Group progress is stored in the internal __consumer_offsets topic, so consumers resume where they stopped.

steps.title: Producer sends a record
steps.text: The producer picks a partition from the key hash, so equal keys keep their order.

steps.title: Brokers store the log
steps.text: The leader appends to its log and followers replicate; acks=all waits for in-sync replicas.

steps.title: KRaft manages metadata
steps.text: The controller quorum elects partition leaders and tracks cluster state.

steps.title: Consumers poll
steps.text: Each group member polls its assigned partitions and processes records in order.

steps.title: Offsets are committed
steps.text: The group records its position so restarts or rebalances resume without loss or reprocessing.
